review: The primary reader personally read the whole page and both halves, then every line in seven broad 3× crops, five rotated marginal/section crops at 4×, and all individual C doubts, cancellations and differences in 5× details. Wider 5× and 7× windows were used when a narrow window cut off a letter. The three margin notes were read upright; field indices, primes, tensor subscripts, inequalities, arrows and equivalence signs were inspected separately. No mathematical completion of the unfinished clause b) was made. No context was opened.
